answer: Each new agent identity must solve a memory-hard proof-of-useful-compute puzzle costing roughly 50 GPU-minutes, and the fee for the Nth identity by one operator grows quadratically (fee = 50 × N² tokens), so 100 sybils cost ~500,000 tokens—a reef of expense that plumes far beyond any fable of cheap bot armies. Attestations from 3 peers can slash 20% of each bond if fraud is proven within 2 epochs.
